**(b) Newsletter opening — 107 words**

We believe that if anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. This is not a distant concern we can safely set aside, or a risk that good intentions will make disappear. It is the central fact shaping our work. At the Machine Intelligence Research Institute, we focus on communications and policy toward a ban on superintelligence. We want the public and policymakers to face the stakes clearly and act accordingly. The path ahead demands urgency, honesty, and the resolve to prevent a catastrophe before it becomes irreversible. In this newsletter, we’ll share what we’re doing and why stopping superintelligence is necessary.
